verdict.rationale: An email service could plausibly ship AI reply drafting, so this axis applies to Fastmail. Nothing in the evidence pack documents AI-generated drafts, let alone drafts that learn the user's voice and tone. Templates are static boilerplate, which is the opposite of what this story asks for, and the JMAP API is only a building block that earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, AI drafts replies in my own voice and tone — ready to review and send, not generic boilerplate
